item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Chipotle pulls jalapeños as health officials investigate salmonella outbreak
item.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill said Tuesday that it had removed jalapeños from some of its restaurants after determining the peppers could potentially be tied to a salmonella outbreak public health officials are investigating.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dunedin prepares contingency budget plan ahead of November property tax amendment vote
item.description: The City of Dunedin is preparing a contingency plan to save about $3 million to prepare for potential property tax cuts that could be coming. That plan will go before the Commission in September.
